_doc: Round 5 paint-over for back at 80 (r5_paint.py). Seeded from round 4's head layers (art/rosace/overrides/drive9/back_80.json) moved by the head-skin offset R4u -> R5xu (0, 0), then re-authored for the round-4 critics' face and hair fixes. Layers with port: true are also painted on the twin build (R5u).

layers.name: eye_near
layers.why: Face critic 2/3: 'the face must read as two eyes plus blush at 80 px; judge the face first at 80, where the donation read happens'. Placed by hand on the 80 px underlay, not scaled from 144.

layers.name: eye_far
layers.why: Face critic 2/3: 'the face must read as two eyes plus blush at 80 px; judge the face first at 80, where the donation read happens'. Placed by hand on the 80 px underlay, not scaled from 144. The far eye sits one row up (the tilt).

layers.name: mouth
layers.why: Attractiveness 3: the asymmetric smile, far corner lifted.
